missionText.value: SAOC exists to promote the culture, hybridisation and appreciation of orchids across South Africa. We do this through a federated network of 21 societies, a nationally accredited judging system first standardised in 1990, and our annual publication Orchids South Africa.

The source markup italicises 'Orchids South Africa' with <em>; missionText is a plain 'text' field in the schema (no rich-text/portableText), so italic emphasis cannot be represented and is dropped. GAP: recorded, not papered over — flag for @docs/Brad if italics matter.

heroImages.note: Migrated by uploading the 4 static files referenced in lib/data/heroImages.ts (orchid-yellow.jpg, orchid-violet.jpg, orchid-pink.jpg, orchid-dark.jpg from public/images/) as Sanity image assets, in that order.
